reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Mike Maples, co-founder and partner of Floodgate.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Mike Maples, co-founder and partner of Floodgate. As a child of the computer revolution, Mike was deconstructing calculators in grade school, writing video games in high school. After his success as an operator, Mike eventually transitioned to become a full-time venture investor in the 2000s.

key_points.text: As a child of the computer revolution, Mike was deconstructing calculators in grade school, writing video games in high school.
After his success as an operator, Mike eventually transitioned to become a full-time venture investor in the 2000s.
I'm not sure I've recorded a conversation with more applicable ideas and advice for company builders.
